column2: the plan defines a minimum vote sample (`min_votes`) and requires an outlier boolean plus chronic-outlier tests, but never specifies what agreement rate (or relative delta) marks a voter as an outlier once eligibility is met. implementations and harness assertions cannot verify the feature consistently.

design tsv compatibility is scoped and tested only for 22-column rows with `body_severity`. committed design run logs include 21-column `findings-classification.tsv` rows (with `finding_reviewers` and `vn_tool` but no `body_severity`). if those are treated as unknown schema, the committed-run analyzer skips design panel votes and under-reports calibration.

the plan appends a `## voter agreement scoreboard` section to code-review `voting-tally.md`, but `_allowed_code_review_headers` (used by `review_and_fix` / `voting.write-tally`) is not updated. valid additive scoreboard output may trigger unrecognized-section warnings during normal log flushes.

optional `--log-root` usage conflicts with missing-log-root failure. running `/voter-calibration` with no flags (the planned usage) exits before scanning the current repo's committed `larch-logs`, so the standalone report path is broken.

the plan centers on `voter_agreement_rows_from_tsv`, but live `voting-tally.md` scoreboards are built during `_render` from in-memory per-slot votes before `findings-classification.tsv` exists. reimplementing eligibility or agree/disagree rules separately for live tally vs `/voter-calibration` tsv ingestion can diverge scoreboards on the same run.

the plan lists 21- and 22-column design schemas but does not require header-driven detection. a parser keyed only on data-row width can mis-map `v3_tool` as `body_severity` or drop the last voter on historical 21-column design headers without `body_severity`.

the new public skill omits yaml frontmatter required by sibling skills (`name`, `description`, `allowed-tools`). omission can break plugin discovery and strict `skill()` permissions for `/voter-calibration`.

plugin-root bootstrap for importing `python/voting.py` is unspecified. if `voter-calibration.py` is the first `skills/*.py` importer of `python/`, `make test-voter-calibration` and direct script runs do not set `claude_plugin_root` like the skill invocation does; a cwd-only `sys.path` insert can fail or import the wrong tree.
